meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **dark spots aur dull skin** ke liye *best practical pick* usually **10% Vitamin C serum** hota hai, especially agar aap beginner ho ya sensitive skin hai. Dermatologist-style guidance ke mutabik, **stable 10% serum + morning sunscreen** brightness aur pigmentation ke liye sweet spot hai; beginners ke liye 10% stable derivative, aur stubborn spots ke liye 15% tak ja sakte ho.[3]

Aapke liye short recommendation:

- **Best overall:** **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** — dull skin aur pigmentation ke liye balanced option, aur isme **niacinamide + Kakadu plum** bhi hai jo tone-evening mein help kar sakte hain.[13]
- **Best for stubborn dark spots:** **Pilgrim 15% Vitamin C Face Serum** — stronger option, aur source ke mutabik stubborn dark spots ke liye suitable hai.[3]
- **Budget + popular option:** **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** — search results mein commonly listed option hai for brightening.[16]
- **If you want a higher-strength option:** **Foxtale 15% L-Ascorbic Acid Serum** — product page par brightening aur pigmentation-fading claim kiya gaya hai.[14]
- **If you want a mass-market option:** **Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum** — dark spots aur dullness ke liye marketed hai.[12]

Agar aap **safe starting point** chahte ho, to main **10% serum** choose karne ko kahunga, because higher concentration se irritation ka risk badh sakta hai, especially dry/sensitive skin mein.[3]

**Kaise choose karein:**
- **Sensitive skin:** 10% ya stable derivative
- **Oily/combination skin:** 10%–15%
- **Stubborn pigmentation:** 15% ke around
- **Beginners:** 10% se start karo[3]

**Use ka best rule:** serum ko **subah** lagao aur uske baad **sunscreen** zaroor, warna dark spots ka result slow ho sakta hai.[3]

Agar aap chaho, main aapke **budget** ke hisaab se 3 exact options shortlist kar doon:
- **under ₹500**
- **₹500–₹1000**
- **₹1000+**
